title: Lambretta X300 Maxi
description: Engineered for riders seeking confident performance and refined dynamics, the Vespa Lambretta X300 Maxi is engineered for instant twist-and-go urban mobility with generous under-seat utility. At its heart lies a 300cc powertrain delivering 12 HP and 10 Nm of torque, tuned to translate its 110 kg mass into punchy mid-range acceleration. Riders are greeted by an ergonomic Step-Through Upright posture paired with an accessible 765mm seat height that allows easy flat-footing for virtually all rider heights, backed by a 13.5L fuel tank for extended saddle stints.
